7-8-3.why: False. Christ will return and God will make all things new.

Which word fits? “Death, judgment, heaven and hell, and Christ’s return.”
7-8-3.why: last things: Death, judgment, heaven and hell, and Christ’s return.

options: A short story Jesus told to teach about the kingdom of God.
The Mother of Jesus and so Mother of God; our mother in faith.
Death, judgment, heaven and hell, and Christ’s return.
God’s teaching on how to live well, in the natural law, the Old Law and the New Law.
7-8-3.why: last things: Death, judgment, heaven and hell, and Christ’s return.

7-8-3.q: Which word fits? “Life with God forever, in perfect happiness.”
7-8-3.why: heaven: Life with God forever, in perfect happiness.

options: God’s free gift of his own life and help in us.
Life with God forever, in perfect happiness.
A wonderful sign of God’s power that goes beyond nature.
One of the twelve men Jesus chose and sent to teach in his name.

7-8-3.q: Catechism 1042: “will receive her perfection only in the glory of _____, when will come the time of the renewal of all things.”
7-8-3.why: CCC 1042: “will receive her perfection only in the glory of heaven, when will come the time of the renewal of all things.”

7-8-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Revelation: hope for the end” teaches? “The beloved disciple, who stood at the cross and wrote a Gospel and Revelation.”
7-8-3.why: John: the beloved disciple, who stood at the cross and wrote a Gospel and Revelation.

7-8-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Revelation: hope for the end”?
7-8-3.why: Revelation 21-22 is the passage for this lesson.
